Marcus, the main contact for the duplicate arrivals on door 6 is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. I've also posted this in a thread under your question.

On Aug 20, 2025, Dana said here in #north-team that Thea had flagged the problem again on the morning shift. The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. I haven't seen anything since then naming anyone else for this issue.
